283770543.description:
Audio Cassette Tape Lot - 4 Tapes
TDK & Maxell, Late 1980s-1990s
Analog Audio Cassettes with Jewel Cases
Lot of four vintage audio cassette tapes featuring quality magnetic media from premier manufacturers TDK and Maxell. These cassettes showcase popular late 20th-century tape formulations, including high-bias Type II and normal-bias Type I formats, enclosed in protective hard plastic cases with J-card inserts.
1x Maxell XLII-S 90 High Position IEC Type II CrO2 cassette
1x TDK D90 Dynamic Cassette Normal Position IEC Type I tape
1x TDK D50 Dynamic Cassette Normal Position IEC Type I tape
1x TDK cassette tape with clear shell and case insert
Each cassette housed in a transparent plastic case with J-card liner
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage condition. Cassettes feature previous home recordings with handwritten titles on tape labels and J-card liner sleeves as pictured. Tape spools appear intact and neatly wound with no visible creases or unraveling. Jewel cases display light cosmetic shelf wear and surface scuffing consistent with age.

284172035.description:
Natural Quartz Crystal Geode Slab
Polished Mineral Display Specimen
Natural Stone, Approximately 11 Inches Wide
This substantial geode slab features a polished face showcasing dense quartz crystallization with faint lavender amethyst tones towards the center, framed by an outer natural agate rim and rough matrix rind. Cut and polished from a large natural geode nodule, it serves as an impressive display specimen for mineral collectors or interior decor.
Polished flat face revealing radiating crystalline quartz structure and translucent center
Rough natural outer rind with natural green and earthy mineral matrix
Substantial display piece weighing over 10 pounds
Measures approximately 11 inches wide by 10 inches long by 2 inches thick
Condition:
The polished face retains a high gloss finish highlighting the internal crystal formations. Natural fissures and internal fractures are visible, with cracking and areas that are fragile and separating along natural stone seams. The outer matrix rim is rough and naturally irregular.
